written.headline: Anthropic’s $81.3 billion IPO tests AI’s circular financing model
written.summary: Anthropic priced its shares at $83, raising $81.3 billion in the largest U.S. IPO to date and valuing the company at about $1.5 trillion. Supplier‑investors such as Amazon and Google hold stakes worth over $150 billion, highlighting the circular financing where the same firms fund and buy AI services.

written.headline: Sarvam AI’s Token Factory hosts mostly Chinese models on Indian GPUs, sparking sovereign AI debate
written.summary: Sarvam AI launched its Token Factory inference platform on November 16, offering eight open-weight models via an OpenAI‑compatible API on GPU clusters in India, six of which are from Chinese firms. The company received a ₹98.68 crore government GPU subsidy for building indigenous models.

written.headline: Disseqt AI raises $8 million to expand enterprise AI governance platform
written.summary: Disseqt AI, an Irish‑headquartered startup that provides testing and compliance tools for AI agents, secured $8 million in a funding round led by Gresham House Ventures. The capital will be used to grow its global enterprise customer base, open operations in London, and increase hiring in India.
